evidence: Implements BIP 352 silent payment receiving, adding sp() descriptors, SilentPaymentDescriptorScriptPubKeyMan, and block scanning.
rationale: Introduces major user-facing privacy capabilities to the wallet through BIP 352 silent payment reception. While solving address reuse and transaction graph linkage without compromising privacy is a high user-value addition, as a brand-new feature it fits strategic milestone priority rather than critical release-blocking bug/fund-safety fixes.
